recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing a separate reduced/example DocumentReference type binding would conflict with FHIR-32578 and FHIR-28078; any future split should come from a new OO terminology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32822 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 OO change request noting that Composition.type and DocumentReference.type used different preferred value sets and suggesting a common binding. Its resolution/comments focused on moving DocumentReference.type away from the old HITSP C80-specific value set to a non-C80 document type value set.
initial_application: No commit message in the local git history explicitly named FHIR-32822. The apparent application was commit cebeac615e0c434ff755a1aa763781d2cf61c8c2, which changed DocumentReference.type from bindingName DocumentC80Type and ValueSet/c80-doc-typecodes to bindingName DocumentType and ValueSet/doc-typecodes.
additional_context: OO minutes from 2022-01-18 record a motion to accept John Moehrke's recommendation for FHIR-32822, remove C80 from the URL/references, and coordinate with FHIR-32578. FHIR-32578 later resolved that DocumentReference.type should use the same doc-typecodes value set already used by Composition. FHIR-28078 was Applied in 2025 and explicitly says build.fhir.org/valueset-doc-typecodes.html has been applied as a preferred binding to DocumentReference.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active resource entries in source/fhir.ini include Composition and DocumentReference, and current StructureDefinition source binds both type elements with preferred strength and bindingName DocumentType to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/doc-typecodes.

related_jiras.note: Published companion issue resolved that DocumentReference.type should use the doc-typecodes value set already used by Composition.
Applied 2025 issue explicitly confirms the same preferred doc-typecodes binding for DocumentReference.type.
No-change issue confirms the old c80-doc-typecodes reference was no longer used in R4B/R5.
